Common.title: Shibusawa Eiichi Diary

Common.descriptionFull: Diaries and meeting schedules of Shibusawa Eiichi from the Shibusawa Eiichi Denki Shiryo, supplementary volumes 1 and 2. Built as an output of the 2020 research project "Restructuring and utilization of the Shibusawa Eiichi Denki Shiryo text data using TEI", supported by the National Museum of Japanese History.
